description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Fire/Ice/Lightning Ability Boost, Triplecast Fire/Ice/Lightning, Unlimited Fire/Ice/Lightning Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Fire/Ice/Lightning Abilities, Fire/Ice/Lightning Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Fire/Ice/Lightning Abilities; Ends after using 8 Fire/Ice/Lightning abilities
TP Max: AOE Fire/NE, Ice/NE or Lightning/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1 under En-Fire, En-Ice or En-Lightning

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
Single-target Fire/Ice/Lightning/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Fire/Ice/Lightning Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least Lv.0/2 En-Fire/Ice/Lightning
WS Blue: Lv.2 En-Fire/Ice/Lightning Stack to user
WS Gold: During Tactical Awoken Mode, Fire/Ice/Lightning Ability Damage +50% & Quadcast Fire/Ice Lightning 1 to user
